messages.subject: International Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Complex Stakeholder Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Rowland Sutton Executive Search Team,

Your work on CEO, C-suite and senior leadership appointments across commercial, government and complex organisations aligns with my executive background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where institutional trust, stakeholder alignment and disciplined execution are central to performance. I am internationally mobile and open to cross-border mandates.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
